articles.title: Natref Operational Update

articles.summary: Johannesburg, South Africa – Sasol Limited (JSE: SOL; NYSE: SSL) has released its audited operating and financial results for the year ended 30 June 2026. Improved operational performance, continued cost management and disciplined capital allocation enabled the company to benefit from more supportive market conditions during the final quarter of the financial year, resulting in stronger earnings and further balance-sheet strengthening.
articles.title: Sasol delivers stronger FY2026 performance and strengthens financial resilience
